_about: Typed schema of the Moog One .m1p preset format / /p OSC namespace, derived by static analysis. No instrument was contacted.

_evidence_grades.TESTED: reproduced by running the analysis over the files on disk
_evidence_grades.READ: read out of a binary or file on disk

las_frontend_embedded.what: 580 presets carved out of the las-frontend binary (firmware 1.5.0), incl. the factory INIT resource

librarian_db.what: 527 preset rows from two SQLite librarian databases

_default_fields.factory_default: value in the JUCE BinaryData resource INIT_m1p carved out of las-frontend (firmware 1.5.0), /p/version 6. This is the factory INIT patch. [READ]
_default_fields.librarian_slot1_INIT: value in the row named INIT (id=1, /p/version 14) of this unit's librarian DB. That row is user-writable and HAS been edited on this unit; it is NOT a reliable default. Provided only for comparison. [READ]

_placeholders.{t}: timbre index, 1..3 (plus the literal 'O' pseudo-timbre at /p/part/t/O/p/tune/*)

value_sample: "MOD Wheel controls Filter Cutoff. XY Pad controls Wave Angle Mod And OSC Mix Position."
"MW BRINGS IN TREMOLO. XY ADJUSTS STEREO AUTOPAN. TURN THE FX ON IF YOU WANT CHORUS, DELAY, AND REVERB."

"CLASSIC STRING SYNTH SOUND.
ENSEMBLE FX FOR SYNTH 1 (TURNED OFF)
REVERB  MASTER FX (TURNED ON)
MOD WHEEL  - AMP ATTACK TIME
AFTERTOUCH - VOLUME OF OSC 2
X PAD - MOVE TO THE RIGHT FOR OSC 3
Y PAD - FILTER
"

"PLAY C3, D3 & E3 TO START ALL 3 SEQUENCES.

KICK - SEQUENCE IS SHORTER TO GET DIFFERENT RHYTHMS.  MOD WHEEL FOR PITCH CHANGES.

SNARE - VELOCITY WILL CHANGE OSC 3 LEVEL.

HATS - X/Y PAD FOR TONAL CHANGES."

"BASS, LEAD & CHIMES.

BASS - USE MOD WHEEL FOR MIXING FROM SVF TO LADDER.  USE Y TO ALTER SVF FILTER.

LEAD - USE AFTERTOUCH FOR SLIGHT VIBRATO.

CHIMES - USE X TO ADD RESONANCE."

"UNISON BASS.

USE THE MOD WHEEL TO CHANGE FROM LADDER TO SV FILTER.

USE THE X/Y FOR FILTER CHANGES."

modmatrix_expression_slots._what: /p/part/t/{t}/p/modmatrix/matrix_expression_slots is a flat JSON array, exactly 7 tokens per mod-matrix entry, in entry order (verified: 300/300 timbre instances in the 222-preset corpus, 0 mismatches). [TESTED]
modmatrix_expression_slots._method: ids decoded by aligning each 7-token group against the /p/part/t/{t}/p/modmatrix/entry/{i}/ {src,src_a,ctl,ctl_a,tr,tr_a,dst} strings of the same preset, over 1329 presets; entries with mute=true excluded because their name fields go stale. [TESTED]
